propositions: A guard script must detect and fail on any reintroduction of deprecated 'Success Criteria' vocabulary outside of a count-pinned allowlist of deliberate carve-outs.
Three live prose sites (completion.py, test_completion_verifier.py, sample-ticket-log.jsonl) must be migrated from 'Success Criteria' to 'Acceptance Criteria' terminology.
The guard must enforce count parity for allowlisted phrases—failing on both increases and decreases—so exemptions remain non-vacuous and do not silently accumulate.
Bare tokens 'SC' and 'SCs' are scoped to only production reviewer, guide, routing, and generated-guide paths; bare tokens outside those paths must not trigger the guard.
The root Makefile lint target must wire the guard so local and CI runs check for vocabulary drift deterministically.

Four permanent semantic carve-outs (T2 experiment language, definition-of-done probes, captured Jira fixtures, and historical citations) must be allowlisted at their exact pinned counts and remain byte-stable.
